title: Endpoint Hayes-class Möbius-convolution bound
statement: For every integer ell >= 200 and n equal to 2 ell + 1 or 2 ell + 2, let M_k(e) be the sum of the polynomial Möbius function over degree-k monic binary polynomials in principal-unit class e modulo x^(ell+1), and let V_d be the classes represented by 1+a_1 x+...+a_d x^d. Then the absolute value of sum over 1 <= d < ell of d times the sum over u in V_d of M_(n-d)(u^(-1)) is at most 2^ell.

provenance.source: Axeyum gf2-lemire lane; exact group-ring logarithmic-derivative decomposition of the endpoint discrepancy

notes: This is the explicit parity-breaking inequality left after the exact identity Delta_(ell,n)=sum_(1<=d<ell) d sum_(u in V_d) M_(n-d)(u^(-1)). The bounded native operations identity_class_mobius_convolution and inverse_mobius_fourier_regroup check the identity, its annihilator-depth regroup, and finite instances but do not prove this quantified estimate. The Berlekamp/inverse stationary-fibre and annihilator-energy reports measure possible van-der-Corput inputs without granting theorem credit. The separate conjectured facts F:gf2-berlekamp-annihilator-energy-bound and F:gf2-berlekamp-simultaneous-coset-square-root-bound would improve only the pointwise tail and are not sufficient for this full signed aggregate. The threshold 200 is where the bound combines with the independently certified degree-1-through-400 range. A valid proof must preserve cancellation across d; summing absolute values of the exact terms is insufficient. No Autogenesis operation is registered because no checker establishes the universal bound.
